Dim Flashing Lights-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Flash-dimming marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe 调暗闪烁光线 in iOS Settings — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Official Settings vocabulary — lead with 调暗闪烁光线

Apple's zh-Hans Settings UI uses 调暗闪烁光线 for Dim Flashing Lights. Related commerce phrasing includes 调暗闪光, 调暗频闪, 减弱闪烁, 视频闪烁, and 频闪光线. Avoid literal inventions like 调暗闪烁灯光 that do not match Settings or User Guide wording. English listings say "Dim Flashing Lights" or "Dim strobing lights"; zh-Hans storefront copy should use 调暗闪烁光线 and context-appropriate flash vocabulary — not Reduce Motion's 减少动态效果 or Reduce White Point's 降低白点.

Motion menu vs Display & Text Size menu — mention both paths honestly

English iOS 26 and AbilityNet-style guides place Dim Flashing Lights under Settings → Accessibility → Motion. Apple's current zh-CN iPhone User Guide (support.apple.com/zh-cn/guide/iphone/iph0b691d3ed/ios, section 减少视频中的闪烁和频闪光线) documents the toggle under 辅助功能 → 显示与文字大小 → 调暗闪烁光线. Listing copy can note both paths when your gallery shows Settings captures — without claiming the feature moved or implying two different features.

Dim Flashing Lights vs Reduce Motion — do not conflate

Reduce Motion tones down animations, parallax, and zoom transitions — 减少动态效果. Dim Flashing Lights detects and dims flashing or strobing in supported video — 调暗闪烁光线. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply global animation reduction when your English source only markets video flash dimming — and should not upgrade Reduce Motion badges to flash-dimming claims unless that is what the frame shows.

No epilepsy or seizure-prevention claims

US marketing sometimes mentions photosensitivity, epilepsy, or seizure risk. zh-Hans listing copy should describe system flash-dimming behavior and supported media compatibility — not medical treatment, diagnosis, therapeutic outcomes, or guarantees that flashing content is safe. AppLocale FAQ

Is Dim Flashing Lights the same as Reduce Motion?

No. Reduce Motion covers toned-down animations and motion-sensitive UI transitions — 减少动态效果. Dim Flashing Lights covers on-device detection and dimming of flashing or strobing in supported video — 调暗闪烁光线. See our Reduce Motion listing guide only if animation reduction is your lead marketing claim.

Is Dim Flashing Lights the same as Reduce White Point or Dim Bright Effects?

No. Reduce White Point dims bright whites across the display — 降低白点. Dim Bright Effects reduces highlight flashes on UI chrome — 减弱明亮效果. Dim Flashing Lights dims detected flash and strobe patterns in supported video — 调暗闪烁光线. Different toggles, different screenshot vocabulary.

Where is Dim Flashing Lights in Settings?

English iOS 26 path: Settings → Accessibility → Motion → Dim Flashing Lights. Apple's zh-CN User Guide documents 调暗闪烁光线 under 辅助功能 → 显示与文字大小. Mention both paths honestly when your gallery shows Settings captures.

Can zh-Hans copy claim seizure prevention?

No. Listing copy should describe system flash-dimming compatibility and supported media behavior — not medical treatment, diagnosis, or guarantees that flashing content is safe in all environments.
